Definition: (only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people)
BiblicalUsage: Na'ur is youth, the days of being young, and the Bible ties it to remembering God early. In Psalm 25:7 David asks God not to remember the sins of his youth, nor his transgressions, and in Psalm 71:5 the psalmist says the Lord has been his trust from his youth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe youth is not a waiting room for faith, it is the time to start it; the God who is trusted from youth is the God who holds through old age, and I would rather begin early than repair late.
